title: Practice 2: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Имбирь очень полезен в ___ (зимний, acc. sg. m.) период.
exercises.prompt: Ginger is very useful in the winter period.
exercises.why: **зимний → зимний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with период). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of зимний (m.): зимний · зимнего · зимнему · зимний (inan.) / зимнего (anim.) · зимним · зимнем; plural: зимние · зимних · зимним · зимние (inan.) / зимних (anim.) · зимними · зимних.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том планировал доделать-таки ___ (кое-какой, acc. sg. f.) работу в выходные.
exercises.prompt: Tom had planned to catch up on some work over the weekend.
exercises.why: **кое-какой → кое-какую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with работу). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension of кое-какой (f.): кое-какая · кое-какой · кое-какой · кое-какую · кое-какой · кое-какой; plural: кое-какие · кое-каких · кое-каким · кое-какие (inan.) / кое-каких (anim.) · кое-какими · кое-каких.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
